settings.for_plan_sellers_adds_a_watermark_opens: For plan sellers. Adds a watermark, opens the viewer without toolbar, measuring or exports, and hides every model download (viewer links, IFC downloads block, GLB/CSV buttons) and the full-viewer link on this page. Honest limit: this stops casual copying, not a determined person. The model file's URL stays reachable in the page and a model shown in a browser is sent to that browser, so it can be extracted. For plans you must not leak, upload a simplified preview model and deliver the full set after purchase.
